title: Gerrard Rejects the Legacy and Leaves the Crew
summary: Burdened by the apparent fate imposed upon him and by personal losses, Gerrard abandons the Weatherlight before Sisay’s capture draws him back.
narrative: Gerrard was trained to fulfill a role in the Legacy project, yet this destiny had cost people he loved and limited his ability to choose a life of his own. He resisted the premise that his companions should be sacrificed to a plan concealed by Urza.

Before the rescue expedition to Rath, Gerrard walked away from the Weatherlight. Sisay continued to believe he would return; her later abduction by Volrath turned the disputed destiny into a concrete obligation to rescue a person who mattered to him.

This withdrawal is not the same event as the Rath rescue, nor evidence that Gerrard permanently rejected his friends. It captures the conflict between imposed purpose and freely chosen loyalty that shapes the opening of the Weatherlight saga.
